# The Merge Standard

> Published agreements for forming ventures between companies and individuals, from Merge Combinator. Three documents take a partnership from first evaluation to an equity relationship: Explore (30 days, mutual confidentiality plus one named deliverable per party), Pursue (6 months, roles and formation conditions, no equity), and Form (equity for a contributing partner in exchange for defined contributions, vesting on milestones; pre-release draft). The text of each document is the same for every party. Deal-specific terms are blanks and schedules, and a departure from a published default is recorded in the schedule with its reason.

Each document states its version in its first heading block and keeps a changelog at the end. Superseded versions remain published in the archive. The documents are templates provided as is, with no warranty, and are not legal advice.

Every URL below returns plain markdown as `text/plain` with open CORS. No file download and no authentication.

## Documents

- [Explore Agreement](https://mergecombinator.com/standard/explore.md): Stage 01. Version 1.1. 30 days, no equity. Mutual confidentiality, no exclusivity, one named deliverable per party, a review date, non-binding considerations for continuing, independent-contractor relationship, export control, and standard general terms. Blanks are named tokens such as `{{first_party_name}}` and `{{counterparty_name}}`, listed in the field table at the end.
- [Pursue Agreement](https://mergecombinator.com/standard/pursue.md): Stage 02. Version 1.1. 6 months, no equity. Names roles from the Role Taxonomy, states the conditions for forming a company, and restricts each party only from pursuing the same opportunity with a third party without notice.
- [Form Agreement](https://mergecombinator.com/standard/form.md): Stage 03. Version 0.9, pre-release draft, not yet reviewed by counsel. Grants equity to a contributing partner (an individual or an organization) in a new or existing company, vesting on named milestones with a time-based portion. Schedule 1 holds the deal terms, Schedule 2 the default positions by role, and Schedule 3 the terms for forming a new company. Does not cover an investment of money.

## Reference

- [Role Taxonomy](https://mergecombinator.com/standard/roles.md): Version 1.1. The six roles a participant holds under Pursue and Form, and the conditions for holding a seat on a part-time basis.
- [Venture Pipeline and Gates](https://mergecombinator.com/standard/pipeline.md): Version 1.1. The stages from an identified problem to an independent venture, and the evidence required to pass each gate.

## For agents filling in an agreement

- Read the field table at the end of the Explore Agreement. Replace each `{{token}}` with a value. Leave the eight signature tokens alone, since the parties fill those when they sign.
- The deliverables table in section 1 is fixed at three rows. The first two rows name the signing parties. Leave the third row blank if no additional responsible party has a deliverable.
- `review_date` is the effective date plus 30 days.
- Do not change any other text. A proposed change to the text belongs in an issue.
